choices.explain: Asks before every tool, even reading.
choices.label: Strict

choices.explain: Asks before it runs a command or changes a file.
choices.label: Ask first

choices.explain: Runs commands in its sandbox without asking.
choices.label: Go ahead in the sandbox

choices.explain: Runs every tool without asking. Only for a throwaway machine.
choices.label: Never ask

settings.explain: Whether Antigravity asks before it runs a tool, such as a command or a file change.
settings.title: When Antigravity asks

choices.explain: Reads and plans; changes nothing until you agree.
choices.label: Plan only

choices.explain: Edits files on its own, asks before commands.
choices.label: Edit without asking

choices.explain: Decides on its own which actions need your OK.
choices.label: Automatic (preview)

settings.explain: How much Antigravity may do on its own. It can be changed for one session in the CLI.
settings.title: Agent mode

choices.explain: Commands run with all your rights.
choices.label: Off

settings.explain: Runs terminal commands in a sandbox.
settings.title: Sandbox for commands

choices.explain: May touch any file you can.
choices.label: Anywhere

settings.explain: Whether Antigravity may read and write files outside the project folder.
settings.title: Files outside the project
